dossier.summary: Norwood Equipment Rental rents earthmoving and lifting equipment to contractors in the Carolinas from four yards.

side_events.title: Rental operators barbecue
side_events.note: Most of the yards from both states stay for it. Ravi will be at the Fieldstone table.

data.personal_line: Four yards serving contractors across two states usually means the machine a crew needs on Monday is sitting at the wrong yard on Friday. Twenty minutes at the stand is enough to see how our dispatch board moves it before the call comes in.
